name: Red Laser Lasgun
author: crystal-mods
description: Renders the Astra Militarum lasgun as a glowing RED laser beam (muzzle to target) with ZERO side effects on other weapons. A BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP) plugin draws a per-shot additive, camera-facing beam (bright core + glow halo) using its own material and colours (shared game assets are never modified), and hides the original flying bolt. Affects all AM las weapons (Lasgun, Hot-Shot, Las Pistol, Multilaser, Lascannon).

targets.weapons: All Astra Militarum las weapons (effect name contains 'LasGun')

compatibility.note: Runtime plugin (BepInEx/plugins/RedLaserLasgun.dll only). It modifies no asset bundle, so it has NO file conflicts and needs no compatibility patch.
compatibility.bepinex-framework: Required — provides the BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP) runtime this plugin loads under.
compatibility.the-great-crusade: Compatible. That mod edits startup_assets_all.bundle; this only adds a plugin DLL.
compatibility.tc-localization: Compatible. Coexists with TCFix.dll in BepInEx/plugins/.

config: BepInEx/config/com.crystalmods.redlaserlasgun.cfg — tune Width, GlowWidthMul, Duration, HideBolt, color R/G/B, Glow (edit + relaunch).
